title: Final Review: Mythos Convergence Demo and Capability Sign-Off
goal: Demonstrate end-to-end that AegisPT now performs cross-target attack composition. Single demo run starts on a web app, captures a token, pivots to internal infrastructure via SMB or LDAP, and produces verified critical findings. This is the proof-of-capability milestone for the substrate investment.
scope: Run a demonstration scenario against a controlled lab environment. Live capture of evidence-graph contents, picker decisions, cross-target chain. Written demo report. Update AGENT_SYSTEM_MAP.md to reflect new capability baseline. Decide what comes next.
generation_reason: Closes the 17-task Mythos convergence plan with a tangible demonstration. Operator on 2026-05-15 set the goal as 'the best pentest tool that exists' - this checkpoint validates whether the substrate investment delivered the cross-target reasoning that competitors cannot easily match.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Demo + report + roadmap-update only. No new code in this task.
constraints.controlled_lab_only: Demo must run against a controlled lab target (Gruyere + lab AD + lab SMB share). NOT against production systems or third-party services without written authorization.

success_criteria: Single demo run produces: (a) web-app exploitation with confirmed finding (verifier confirmed), (b) credential or token captured, (c) cross-target pivot using captured value via an exec_plan with SMB or LDAP step, (d) follow-up finding in the new target with provenance pointing back to the web finding.
Evidence graph for the run contains both web and infra entities with edges showing the captured-value lineage.
Demo report (docs/checkpoints/2026-mythos-final-demo.md) captures: timeline, decisions, evidence, screenshots, cost per advance.
AGENT_SYSTEM_MAP.md is updated to a new baseline (sections 3, 4, 5, 10 reflect post-Mythos state).
Next-phase work (target-pack expansion: AD, cloud, mobile, OT) is named with rough scope but NOT queued as concrete tasks yet - that is a separate planning session with the operator.

acceptance_criteria: Cross-target chain is concretely demonstrated (not asserted).
Verifier verdict is recorded for the final critical finding.
Next-phase scope is sketched, with operator approval gate before any new tasks are queued.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
Tasks #334, #335, #336 must show as DONE in DONE_LOG.md.
after_completion: Record in NEXT_TASK.md that the Mythos convergence backlog is complete and no active task is queued. Operator must open a planning session before scheduling the next phase (target-pack expansion: AD, cloud, mobile, OT). Do NOT auto-queue next-phase tasks.

out_of_scope: Pre-queuing next-phase tasks (must go through operator planning).
